_comment: Synthetic demo project UI strings. The consentParagraphs below are a PLACEHOLDER for a demo that enrolls nobody. They are not approved consent text and must not be copied into a project that collects data from real participants. See CREATING-A-PROJECT.md.

welcome.title: AI-MED Core Demo
welcome.subtitle: A synthetic scenario for checking that your installation works
welcome.instructionsLead: Before you begin, read the following:
bullets: You will interview a digital standardized patient (DSP) played by a language model
Ask questions about symptoms, history, and exposure, as you would in a consultation
Request examinations and tests from your nursing team when you want them
The patient and the case are entirely invented for software testing
There is no correct diagnosis, no score, and no time limit
welcome.disclaimer: This is a synthetic training exercise using AI. The patient does not exist and the case is fabricated. Nothing here is medical advice. Do not enter personal or sensitive data.
consentParagraphs: This is a software demonstration, not a research study. No one is being enrolled and no consent is being sought.
The conversation you have on this screen is stored as a transcript by the application you are running, on infrastructure you control.
A real project MUST replace this notice with its own informed consent text, approved by the IRB or ethics committee that oversees it. Do not field a study using this text.
For guidance on supplying your own consent text, see CREATING-A-PROJECT.md in this repository.

chat.scenarioDescription: Scenario: you are seeing a patient who has come to your clinic with a three-day history of elbow discomfort. Ask whatever you would normally ask, or request an examination from your nursing team.
chat.endThankYouMessage: That is the end of the demo. Your installation is working. You can close this page.

feedback.loadingDetail: This will take just a few seconds
